overview_description.description:
Freshpaint is a data platform that develops software that facilitates marketing by collecting customer data. It connects the customer data from the site or app to marketing and analytics tools. It also automates tedious work so engineering can focus on the product. Freshpaint is capable of integrating marketing and analytics tools with one click. The platform helps product, data, and growth teams set up the customer behavioral data they need to build a better product, drive engagement, and improve retention.

The company was co-founded by Michael Malis and Steven Fitzsimmons.

about_short_description.short_description: Freshpaint is a data platform that facilitates marketing by collecting customer data.

product.name: BAA Supported Platform
product.description: A platform that centralizes website data collection under a Business Associate Agreement to ensure HIPAA compliance for healthcare organizations.

product.name: Safe By Default Approach
product.description: A data handling method that blocks sensitive data from being shared with non-HIPAA-compliant tools unless explicitly permitted.

product.name: Complete Visitor Journey
product.description: A system that creates anonymous visitor identifiers to track customer journeys without exposing personal health information.

product.name: Secure Server-Side Connections
product.description: Server-side integrations that allow marketing and analytics tools to function without accessing sensitive patient data.

product.name: Web Tracker Manager
product.description: A tool that monitors and provides visibility into all trackers installed on a healthcare website to maintain HIPAA compliance.
